description: Search the Lium documentation for pages matching the query. Use for how-to questions (renting, SSH, templates, providing GPUs); for live GPU availability or prices use search_gpus or get_gpu_prices instead. Optionally filter by audience (providers, validators, pod-users, developers); without one, pages for the other side (renter or provider, guessed from the query) rank lower.

audience.description: Filter results to a specific audience section

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 50)

name: search
title: Search Lium docs
